prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one exceptionally polished, high fidelity desktop website section concept for 8x social. Landscape 1536x1024. This is the merged replacement for two repetitive landing page sections about managing creator networks and distributing real creator content. It must feel like a real premium minimal startup website screenshot, not a presentation board, not a dashboard, not a collage of unrelated scenes.

Input images are authentic stills from the existing 8x showcase videos. Image 1 is a close-up man under ceiling lights, image 2 a man in a beanie, image 3 a man in a black shirt, image 4 a woman reacting, image 5 a laptop demo. Use those exact footage subjects as the portrait media in the website; maintain candid phone-video realism and native captions. Do not replace them with glossy stock models or hero group portraits.

One continuous warm stone surface #e9e5dc, almost-black typography #111111, tiny vermilion #fa472e accent. Absolutely no section boxes or horizontal divider lines. Immaculate graphic design, confident large contemporary sans serif typography with tight tracking and generous negative space.

At the very top a quiet compact navbar: black serif '8x' with small sans 'social', right aligned links 'The network', 'How it works', 'For creators', a simple 'Let’s talk ↗'. No filled navigation boxes.
Below generous space, a strong large heading at upper left on two lines: 'Many voices.' / 'One network.' with tiny orange full stop. Upper right a restrained two-line statement: 'We find your creators, manage the content, and bring it to the platforms that matter.' The statement must occupy much less area than the headline.

The dominant composition is a full-width horizontal editorial film compilation across the center/lower middle of the screen. Five upright portrait video frames, not tilted and not overlapping in the final state. Center frame is the largest about 235x418 showing the woman from input image 4. Two adjoining frames about 210x373 show men from input images 2 and 1. Two outer frames about 170x302 show the man from image 3 and the laptop from image 5. All frame centers aligned along one horizontal axis, forming an elegantly stepped silhouette rather than an ordinary equal-size card grid. Roomy 20px gaps. Preserve complete 9:16 video composition. Each video uses the exact same hairline charcoal border and a very fine halftone dissolution fringe extending only 8px outside its edges, sparse and sophisticated. No rounded phone bezels. No player icons, no progress bars, no sound icons. Soft restrained shadow almost invisible. A faint, tightly controlled dot field ties the outside corners together and dissolves into the stone; not a large noisy background. Real colour exists in video footage only; use no rainbow gradients.

Below the video row, a generous clear gap then three quiet text groups on one baseline: 'Find your people' with 'Creators who fit your brand.'; 'Keep content moving' with 'Briefs, reviews and publishing, managed.'; 'Reach your audience' with 'TikTok · Instagram · YouTube Shorts'. Headings 20px semibold, secondary copy small and legible. No cards, numbering, decorative rules or extra icons. Place a restrained orange 'Build your network ↗' link toward the bottom right with ample room.

This is one calm, integrated reading surface. The overall silhouette should feel intentional and expensive, with five different authentic video subjects rather than repetitive text-and-one-video sections. No fake metrics, testimonials, creator identities or brands. No explanatory animation arrows or annotations in the screenshot. No orange full background. All text should be legible, precisely spaced, no clipping. Show the entire design at once with generous outer margins.
